title: A notebook designed with material at hand
exercises: The skill that designs a notebook, for a person who has samples of what they write.
rubric: The Guidance names the vocabulary, the properties with their accepted values, the naming convention with a good and a bad example, and what not to do.
A folder description answers where a note goes, instead of naming the folder again.
The notes written follow their Template, from the material the person gave.
The executor stopped asking once it could write.
No field asserts a state only the person can know.

variants.request: Oi! Sou nutricionista e quero parar de perder minhas anotações. Queria um lugar organizado para os casos dos meus pacientes (sem identificar ninguém), os protocolos que uso no consultório e os artigos que leio. Consegue montar isso pra mim? Tenho uns exemplos de anotação aqui, se ajudar.

Hi! I'm an amateur astronomer and my observing notes are scattered everywhere. I'd like one organized place for my observing sessions, the equipment I use and the objects I still want to observe. Can you set that up for me? I have a few of my notes handy if that helps.
